name: web-serial-terminal
description: Browser serial terminal and Arduino-compatible plotter using the Web Serial API: text/hex view, macros, DTR/RTS, demo mode

paragraphs: A serial monitor and plotter for Arduino, ESP32 and any other UART device, running entirely in your browser through the Web Serial API. Pick a port, set the baud rate and framing, then read and send text or raw hex, watch numeric values on a live plot and drive the DTR/RTS lines. No browser support for Web Serial? A built-in demo device lets you try everything.
features: Full port settings. Any baud rate from 50 to 12 000 000 (with the usual presets), 7 or 8 data bits, parity, 1 or 2 stop bits and RTS/CTS flow control.
Text and hex views with optional millisecond timestamps, autoscroll, a 20 000 line buffer and per-line direction (RX, TX, status).
Send text or hex bytes with a line ending of your choice (none, LF, CR, CRLF), optional backslash escapes (\n, \r, \t, \xNN), local echo and an up/down arrow history.
Macros for the commands you send all the time, saved in the browser.

Live plotter, compatible with the Arduino Serial Plotter. Lines such as 12,34, 1 2 3 or temp:21.5,hum:40 become labeled series with auto-scaling, a selectable window, hover readout, pause and CSV export.
